title: Exact evaluation retries replay through the service and the words after a revision or a completion
outcome: Exact evaluation retries replay through the service and the words after a revision or a completion
acceptance: a fresh submission carrying the old basis with a different payload still refuses WorkRevisionConflict, and a submission on a completed item with a new payload refuses without effects
word-level tests cover the same explicit and keyless retries after a revision and after done, in src/work_service/evaluate/tests/review.rs and src/verbs/tests/evaluate/review.rs

work_evaluate_on resends an identical explicit-key and an identical keyless submission after the item revision changed (mode pin) and after the item completed, and receives the committed attempt as a replay (same hash, replayed true) with no new record and no feed effect; the replay probe keeps the submitted acceptance basis, resolves citations against the recorded run, and runs the same preflight

completion.summary: work_evaluate_on derives the attempt identity from the submitted basis and the active-or-latest run, resolves citations against that recorded run, and recovers the committed attempt through the read-only replay probe before the revision and active-run guards; a stale fresh submission still refuses WorkRevisionConflict with no effects and a completed item admits nothing new. Service and word tests cover explicit and keyless retries after a mode-pin revision and after done. RED logs/19, GREEN logs/20, final sequence logs/22; gates for the round recorded here.
